acceptance_criteria.text: verify_release raises TrustError 'links not covered by the signed release' for a link the manifest does not list: link to a package folder, link to a file, dangling link, link inside vendor/.
positive: Link json to a folder with __init__.py fails
negative: A clean signed release still verifies
edge: A dangling link and a link inside vendor/ fail
regression: Existing linked-folder and linked-vendor tests still pass

acceptance_criteria.text: runtime_copy_check returns a problem naming the link, for the same cases, and passes a copy with no link.
positive: Link json, a link to a file and a dangling link each give a problem
negative: A copy with only a changed listed file passes
edge: Checked with a passing signature check, so only the link is at fault
regression: Importable-suffix and compiled-file checks still work

acceptance_criteria.text: Links inside a real stories/ or __pycache__ folder are ignored; a link itself named stories or __pycache__ is not.
positive: A link under stories/SAT-1 and under __pycache__ still verifies
edge: The walk prunes real folders of those names
regression: Story folders with ordinary files still verify

acceptance_criteria.text: Folder links are never followed: the check lists a folder link without walking into it.
positive: A link to a folder with __init__.py is reported as one entry
negative: Files inside the linked folder are not listed
edge: A link to a folder outside the tree does not hang the walk
